title_o: Overcoming intuition: Metacognitive difficulty activates analytic reasoning.

replications.journal: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science
replications.quote: These results do not support the hypothesis that syllogism performance is higher when the font is harder to read; the difference between conditions was slightly in the opposite direction and not distinguishable from zero (d = −0.03, 95% CI = [−0.08, 0.01], vs. original d = 0.64).
